issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973

They are not covered by AdGuard Base, AdGuard Spanish/Portuguese, EasyList or uBO filters (none of them has any rule for ggmax.com.br). > > **Where they appear** (checked all 191 category pages on 2026-10-10): > - First 2-3 slots of 17 category pages, 48 ads total. Examples: https://ggmax.com.br/jogos/brawl-stars , /jogos/free-fire , /jogos/roblox , /jogos/valorant , /jogos/league-of-legends , /outros/discord > - Search results, e.g. https://ggmax.com.br/busca/steam%20key > - Not seen on the homepage or the "Anúncios parecidos" block on listing pages. > > **How to identify them:** > - Sponsored cards contain `span.promotion-label` (text "Ad", title "Anúncio patrocinado") and links with `rel="sponsored"`. > - Card wrapper: `.category__announcements__announcement` on category pages, `.search__announcements__announcement` on search pages. > - Click tracking: `POST https://ggmax.com.br/api/gg-ads/click` (body `{ad_token}`). > - Tracking cookie `gg-ads-session` (180 days), sent to the API as header `x-gg-session`. > > **Suggested rules** (cosmetic rule tested: hides exactly the sponsored cards on category and search pages, no regular listings affected): > ``` > ggmax.com.br##div:has(> .announcement-box > .promotion-label) > ||ggmax.com.br/api/gg-ads/ > ``` > > Screenshot: sponsored cards outlined in red (the "Ad" label in the bottom-right corner of each card). ### Screenshots

Examples: https://ggmax.com.br/jogos/brawl-stars , /jogos/free-fire , /jogos/roblox , /jogos/valorant , /jogos/league-of-legends , /outros/discord > - Search results, e.g. https://ggmax.com.br/busca/steam%20key > - Not seen on the homepage or the "Anúncios parecidos" block on listing pages. > > **How to identify them:** > - Sponsored cards contain `span.promotion-label` (text "Ad", title "Anúncio patrocinado") and links with `rel="sponsored"`. > - Card wrapper: `.category__announcements__announcement` on category pages, `.search__announcements__announcement` on search pages. > - Click tracking: `POST https://ggmax.com.br/api/gg-ads/click` (body `{ad_token}`). > - Tracking cookie `gg-ads-session` (180 days), sent to the API as header `x-gg-session`. > > **Suggested rules** (cosmetic rule tested: hides exactly the sponsored cards on category and search pages, no regular listings affected): > ``` > ggmax.com.br##div:has(> .announcement-box > .promotion-label) > ||ggmax.com.br/api/gg-ads/ > ``` > > Screenshot: sponsored cards outlined in red (the "Ad" label in the bottom-right corner of each card). ### Screenshots

issue.body:
# Sorry. The website is infected by AdShield, Inc.

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

comment.body:
There are still ad leftovers. See https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues/111.
Response was:
> Should NOT be handled by tinyShield userscript.

> Continue in EL and/or AdguardFilters repos.

Suggested filters:
```adblock
lincolnshirelive.co.uk##[data-testid^="commercial-"]
mirror.co.uk##[data-testid^="commercial-"]
```

The built-in report mechanism doesn't allow for reporting it anyway even if tinyShield is enabled.

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973

I was able to reproduce the issue by refreshing the page several times. Enabling Tracking Protection blocks these ads, but it is not enabled by default. Could you update the filters so these ad-serving domains are also blocked for users with the default settings? 2. Screenshots

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973

Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?

# Sorry. The website is infected by AdShield, Inc.

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

issue.title: IDM “Download this video” Panel Disappears on YouTube When AdGuard Base Is Enabled
issue.body:
### Prerequisites

- [x] This site DOES NOT contain sexually explicit material, otherwise use [NSFW-specific form](./new?template=bug_report_NSFW.yml);
- [x] Filters were updated before reproducing an issue;
- [x] AdGuard product version is up-to-date;
- [x] Browser version is up-to-date;
- [x] If the site or app is broken, disabling AdGuard protection resolves an issue.

### What product do you use?

AdGuard Browser Extension

### AdGuard version

AdGuard Browser extension Version 5.5.3.15

### What type of problem have you encountered?

Website or app doesn't work properly

### Which browser(s) do you use?

Chrome

### Which device do you use?

Desktop

### Where is the problem encountered?

https://www.youtube.com/

### Ad Blocking

AdGuard Base filter

### Privacy

_No response_

### Social Widgets

_No response_

### Annoyances

_No response_

### Security

_No response_

### Other

_No response_

### DNS filters

_No response_

### Language-specific

_No response_

### What Stealth Mode options do you have enabled?

_No response_

### Add your comment and screenshots

I had a problem where the floating “Download this video” panel from Internet Download Manager (IDM) stopped appearing on YouTube videos in Chrome. IDM itself was working, but the download panel dI isappeared whenever AdGuard Base was enabled.

I spent some time testing my extensions and filters to find out what was causing it. Eventually, I narrowed the problem down to one specific scriptlet in the AdGuard Base filter.

My configuration

Google Chrome: 155.0.8059.85

IDM Integration Module: 6.43.1

AdGuard Base: Enabled

Other Chrome extensions were also enabled during the final test.

The suspected conflicting rule

I found this rule in my local adguard-base.txt file at line 46519:

youtube.com#%#//scriptlet('json-prune-fetch-response', 'playerResponse.adPlacements playerResponse.playerAds playerResponse.adSlots adPlacements playerAds adSlots', '', '/playlist\?list=|player\?|watch\?[tv]=/')

This scriptlet modifies JSON responses from certain YouTube Fetch requests by removing specified advertisement-related properties. In my testing, it appeared to interfere with the IDM download panel.

The workaround that fixed it for me

I opened AdGuard → Settings → User rules and added this exception:

youtube.com#@%#//scriptlet('json-prune-fetch-response', 'playerResponse.adPlacements playerResponse.playerAds playerResponse.adSlots adPlacements playerAds adSlots', '', '/playlist\?list=|player\?|watch\?[tv]=/')

I left AdGuard Base enabled and kept this exception as the only custom rule needed for the fix.

How I tested it

With AdGuard Base enabled and no exception, the IDM download panel disappeared.

I temporarily disabled all YouTube scriptlets using a broader exception, and the panel came back.

I tested an exception for the XHR response-pruning rule alone, but that did not restore the panel.

I then added the exception for the Fetch response-pruning rule. The IDM panel returned.

To make sure the XHR exception was not needed, I removed it and kept only the Fetch exception.

I completely closed and reopened Chrome, tested another YouTube video, and confirmed that the IDM download panel was still working.

I then enabled my other extensions, including uBlock Origin with EasyList, relaunched Chrome again, and confirmed that the panel continued to work.

Conclusion

In my setup, excluding the json-prune-fetch-response scriptlet restored the missing IDM download panel without disabling AdGuard Base or my other extensions.

I haven't established the exact internal reason why this rule interferes with IDM, but the result was reproducible in my testing.

Could the AdGuard filter maintainers please investigate whether this rule causes a compatibility issue with IDM's YouTube download-panel detection? A proper filter-side fix would be helpful for other users experiencing the same problem.

Workaround: Add the custom exception above under AdGuard User rules and keep AdGuard Base enabled.

I hope this helps anyone else who has the same issue.

Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).

# Sorry. The website is infected by AdShield, Inc.

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

issue.title: IDM “Download this video” Panel Disappears on YouTube When AdGuard Base Is Enabled
issue.body:
### Prerequisites

- [x] This site DOES NOT contain sexually explicit material, otherwise use [NSFW-specific form](./new?template=bug_report_NSFW.yml);
- [x] Filters were updated before reproducing an issue;
- [x] AdGuard product version is up-to-date;
- [x] Browser version is up-to-date;
- [x] If the site or app is broken, disabling AdGuard protection resolves an issue.

### What product do you use?

AdGuard Browser Extension

### AdGuard version

AdGuard Browser extension Version 5.5.3.15

### What type of problem have you encountered?

Website or app doesn't work properly

### Which browser(s) do you use?

Chrome

### Which device do you use?

Desktop

### Where is the problem encountered?

https://www.youtube.com/

### Ad Blocking

AdGuard Base filter

### Privacy

_No response_

### Social Widgets

_No response_

### Annoyances

_No response_

### Security

_No response_

### Other

_No response_

### DNS filters

_No response_

### Language-specific

_No response_

### What Stealth Mode options do you have enabled?

_No response_

### Add your comment and screenshots

I had a problem where the floating “Download this video” panel from Internet Download Manager (IDM) stopped appearing on YouTube videos in Chrome. IDM itself was working, but the download panel dI isappeared whenever AdGuard Base was enabled.

I spent some time testing my extensions and filters to find out what was causing it. Eventually, I narrowed the problem down to one specific scriptlet in the AdGuard Base filter.

My configuration

Google Chrome: 155.0.8059.85

IDM Integration Module: 6.43.1

AdGuard Base: Enabled

Other Chrome extensions were also enabled during the final test.

The suspected conflicting rule

I found this rule in my local adguard-base.txt file at line 46519:

youtube.com#%#//scriptlet('json-prune-fetch-response', 'playerResponse.adPlacements playerResponse.playerAds playerResponse.adSlots adPlacements playerAds adSlots', '', '/playlist\?list=|player\?|watch\?[tv]=/')

This scriptlet modifies JSON responses from certain YouTube Fetch requests by removing specified advertisement-related properties. In my testing, it appeared to interfere with the IDM download panel.

The workaround that fixed it for me

I opened AdGuard → Settings → User rules and added this exception:

youtube.com#@%#//scriptlet('json-prune-fetch-response', 'playerResponse.adPlacements playerResponse.playerAds playerResponse.adSlots adPlacements playerAds adSlots', '', '/playlist\?list=|player\?|watch\?[tv]=/')

I left AdGuard Base enabled and kept this exception as the only custom rule needed for the fix.

How I tested it

With AdGuard Base enabled and no exception, the IDM download panel disappeared.

I temporarily disabled all YouTube scriptlets using a broader exception, and the panel came back.

I tested an exception for the XHR response-pruning rule alone, but that did not restore the panel.

I then added the exception for the Fetch response-pruning rule. The IDM panel returned.

To make sure the XHR exception was not needed, I removed it and kept only the Fetch exception.

I completely closed and reopened Chrome, tested another YouTube video, and confirmed that the IDM download panel was still working.

I then enabled my other extensions, including uBlock Origin with EasyList, relaunched Chrome again, and confirmed that the panel continued to work.

Conclusion

In my setup, excluding the json-prune-fetch-response scriptlet restored the missing IDM download panel without disabling AdGuard Base or my other extensions.

I haven't established the exact internal reason why this rule interferes with IDM, but the result was reproducible in my testing.

Could the AdGuard filter maintainers please investigate whether this rule causes a compatibility issue with IDM's YouTube download-panel detection? A proper filter-side fix would be helpful for other users experiencing the same problem.

Workaround: Add the custom exception above under AdGuard User rules and keep AdGuard Base enabled.

I hope this helps anyone else who has the same issue.

issue.body:
# Sorry. The website is infected by AdShield, Inc.

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

issue.title: Instagram using generated tracking parameters?
issue.body:
### Prerequisites

- [x] I checked the documentation and found no answer;
- [x] I checked to make sure that this issue has not already been filed;
- [x] This is not an ad/bug report.

### Problem description

I noticed recently that I've been seeing Instagram links from friends where there's a clear tracking parameter, but instead of the usual `igshid`, `igsh`, or `igsi` name, the parameter has some random-looking four character name. In the past couple days alone I've seen `psln`, `srtk`, and `exln`. Earlier I've also observed `stkn` and `vrfl`. The value for each is always 12-13 bytes encoded as base64.

I didn't see these parameters in the [specific.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/master/TrackParamFilter/sections/specific.txt) list or anyone else reporting this phenomenon, so I wanted to give a head up that they may be encoding/randomizing their tracking parameters. Given that Instagram is a huge platform (and Meta a notorious tracker), I thought you'd want to know.

### Proposed solution

This is more of a heads up than a specific feature request. The way to address this depends highly on the pattern in the parameters. It may not be worth overcomplicating the matching rules. If it's always 4 lowercase letters, though, it looks like you could use a regex to match them. If that's too broad, you can restrict it to certain paths (I've only seen these on `/reel/` urls).

### Additional information

_No response_

comment.body:
Since ~2026-10-08, Instagram reel share links replace `igsh`/`igsi` with a 4-letter param whose *name rotates per share* but whose *value is the same account-bound share ID*, e.g.:

`stkn rpxt xtok vrfl obrf exln psln cplk mdxt srtk dlrf`

Example: https://www.instagram.com/reel/DeOPRnZhCDj/?xtok=share-id

FYI, some other cleaners have picked these up too:
- https://github.com/crimera/piko/pull/2118
- https://github.com/FredericoReid/InstaCleanLink/pull/1

Reels load fine with no query string. Suggested:

```adblock
||instagram.com/reel/$removeparam=/^[a-z]{4}=/
||instagram.com/p/$removeparam=/^[a-z]{4}=/
```
